typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ATC_DATE as timestamp (),
	ATC_FN as string (),
	BatchId as integer (),
	CurrentDt as string (),
	DataSource as string (),
	Date as string (),
	GetWarpCounts as string (),
	gv_Arch_Main as string (),
	gv_ExtractBalName as string (),
	gv_ExtractJournalName as string (),
	gv_ExtractPath as string (),
	gv_ExtractReport as string (),
	gv_File_Arch_Folder as string (),
	gv_OracleDS as string (),
	gv_OraclePassword as string (),
	gv_OracleProvider as string (),
	gv_OracleUserID as string (),
	gv_ReportPath_Main as string (),
	gv_Report_Arch_Folder as string (),
	gv_Report_Path_Folder as string (),
	gv_strSQLDB as string (),
	gv_strSQLDS as string (),
	gv_strSQLPassword as string (),
	gv_strSqlServerProvider as string (),
	gv_strUserName as string (),
	ReportPeriodEndDt as timestamp (),
	ReportPeriodStartDt as string (),
	Rowcount as integer ()
}

source(output(
		{Column 0} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> Journal
Journal derive({Row count} = right('          ' + toString($Rowcount), 10),
		date = toString($Date)) ~> DerivedColumn11
DerivedColumn11 derive({Row count} = {Row count}) ~> PlaceHolderRowSampling
PlaceHolderRowSampling sink(input(
		Column_0 as string,
		Column_1 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = {Row count},
		Column_1 = date)) ~> BalFile111
